Step:  
1011 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400).  
From 11-16 backward:  
Oct (31 days) → back 15 days to Nov 16 → 224 - 15 = 209 days left.  
Sep (30), Aug (31), Jul (31), Jun (30), May (31), Apr (30), Mar (31), Feb (28) → sum these backward from Oct 31:  
15 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 28 = 227 days back to Feb 28.  
227 - 209 = 18 days earlier than Feb 28 → Feb 10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1011-02-10
